description: This PHP source file is a class test file for the TestLink project, specifically testing the 'testproject' class functionalities such as creation, retrieval, copying, and keyword management. It also contains script logic for testing various methods of the 'testproject' class.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class representing a test project within the TestLink management system, used to manage test projects including creation, copying, and retrieval of data related to test projects.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method to create a new test project with specified parameters like name, color, options, notes, active status, prefix, and public visibility.

methods.name: get_accessible_for_user
methods.description: Retrieve test projects accessible for a specific user, possibly returning a map or list of project IDs.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Retrieve keywords associated with a given test project ID.

methods.name: get_first_level_test_suites
methods.description: Get top-level test suites within a specified test project.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Generate a mapping of keywords for a given test project.

methods.name: get_keywords_tcases
methods.description: Retrieve test cases associated with specific keywords in a test project.

methods.name: get_linked_custom_fields
methods.description: Fetch custom fields linked to a specific test project.

methods.name: gen_combo_test_suites
methods.description: Generate combined or composite test suites based on certain parameters.

methods.name: getReqSpec
methods.description: Retrieve requirement specifications for a test project, optionally filtered by ID.

methods.name: get_srs_by_title
methods.description: Retrieve a specific SRS (Software Requirements Specification) by its title within a test project.
